evidences.evidence_quote: However, in the scenario of micron mechanical vibration, the accuracy of longer wavelength RF signals (e.g., RFID[19], WiFi[20]) is limited.
evidences.evidence_context: The works mentioned above are dedicated to analyzing the frequency of mechanical vibration. Displacement is also an essential parameter of mechanical vibration. However, in the scenario of micron mechanical vibration, the accuracy of longer wavelength RF signals (e.g., RFID[19], WiFi[20]) is limited.
